subject: c-fo-act
title: C.FO.ACT.------DYM.F.
description: Diagram in PCC-25, paired with v1-p341-1. (C)C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) is crossed with DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). C-FO-ACT branches three ways: → PHY-U-P (physical universe particular), → PR-TRS (primary transition), → (R)INT (the reality of intention). (R)INT → DYM-F (the crossing) → (R)INFO-DOC (the reality of information documentation). EXT-DYM (extended dynamics) → (R)INFO-DOC and EXT-DYM → TR (transformation). VT-U-PT (vibrational universe particulars) → EXT-DYM and VT-U-PT → MT-INFO (music information). C-CONT (composite continuance) → VT-U-PT. Structural argument: composite focused activism produces three primary outputs — physical universe particulars, primary transition, and the reality of intention. Real intention produces dynamic functionalism (the crossing partner), which produces the reality of information documentation. Extended dynamics is the hub of the lower part of the diagram — fed by vibrational universe particulars (which is fed by composite continuance), and producing both the reality of information documentation and transformation. Vibrational universe particulars also produces music information. The diagram thus structurally specifies the conditions under which dynamic functionalism becomes productive of *real* documentation rather than gradualist redocumentation: it requires composite focused activism's real intention chain, plus the parallel composite-continuance → vibrational-universe-particulars → extended-dynamics chain. Both must be present.
